purpose: Context-free successor request envelope for A-5 endpoint/schema/mode decision.

observation_pointer.semantics: A-3 Observation Receipt pointer plus resolved receipt payload when available

structure_pointer.semantics: A-4 Structure Receipt pointer plus resolved receipt payload when available

response_body_pointer.semantics: Optional response body evidence pointer; absence degrades API/HYBRID confidence

authority_rule: Pointer is evidence identity; only fields supported by supplied receipt payload may become observed authority.
